summary: Application Services is mostly legacy Carbon C API (Apple Event Manager, ColorSync, Speech Synthesis, PDEPlugIn, HIShape, Translation). BifrOSt covers the pasteboard, the accessibility tree (AT-SPI2 instead of AXUIElement), and printing through CUPS; colour profile conversion exists in the render crate (springboard/render/src/cg/color.rs) but not as an app API; speech synthesis and the print-plug-in and shape APIs have no counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs, springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs, springboard/render/src/clipboard.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_types.rs (Board::best); springboard/src/shell/services/pasteboard_types.rs; wired: springboard/apps/clock-desktop/src/clock/mod.rs (Copy Laps toolbar item, Target::Export, take_export), springboard/apps/clock-desktop/src/main.rs (hands the text to NativePasteboard::general().set_string), springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs
features.note: Text, file URLs, png, html, rtf and uri-list through UTType ids and MIME mapping; only the text-like type reaches the Wayland selection, and no change count is exposed to the Apple name. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Carbon Accessibility: AXUIElement.h, AXRoleConstants.h, AXAttributeConstants.h, AXNotificationConstants.h, AXActionConstants.h
features.note: AT-SPI2 bridge maps app node trees to roles, states and actions (Press, SetValue, Focus). Apps that send no tree appear as a flat list; shell chrome is not in the tree; the bridge is untested with a live Orca.

features.feature: Accessibility text (AXText, attributed strings, text markers)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (theme-24, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No selected-text, visible-range, text-marker or caret events reach the accessibility bridge; rich text is not exposed as attributed strings.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 37 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No live-region announcements, no custom actions beyond press, and SetValue and Focus reach only apps that override ax_set.
Shell magnifier with Original, Invert and Contrast filters. No app-facing API to read or set zoom focus.

features.apple: Core Printing: PMCreatePageFormat, PMCreatePrintSettings, PMCreateSession, PMGetAdjustedPageRect
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/print.rs (PrintInfo, PrintOperation, printers, available); wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (PrintSheet, Setup, Job) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs
features.note: Paper size, orientation, margins, copies and page range, submitted with lp; Save as PDF copies the file. No shell-drawn print sheet, no view pagination, and CUPS presence on the Midget image is unchecked. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-11, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No print panel plug-in mechanism; the print sheet is not shell-drawn yet.

Pure model in the render crate with host unit tests; not yet verified on Midget. Reads ICC matrix/TRC RGB and grey profiles and converts colours between spaces through XYZ with rendering intents. No CMM, no LUT (A2B/B2A) profiles, no display profile handling, and no SDK API for apps.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-10, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No speech synthesis channel or voice API. Screen-reader output goes through Orca on AT-SPI, not through an SDK call.

features.feature: Apple Event Manager (AEDesc, Apple Event dispatch)
features.note: Carbon-era IPC with no BifrOSt counterpart. The control socket RPC and App Intents cover the same app-automation role, not the descriptor format.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 37 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The geometry module has rectangles and points; no shape or region type with boolean operations or hit testing for shapes.
Legacy Carbon translation service for document conversion. Not applicable to BifrOSt.

gaps: Accessibility text: selected text, visible range, text markers and caret events are not exposed through the AT-SPI bridge.
Accessibility announcements (live regions) and custom actions beyond press.
ColorSync: springboard/render/src/cg/color.rs converts between matrix/TRC profiles, but there is no SDK profile or transform API for apps, no LUT-based profile support and no CMM.
Speech synthesis: no SDK voice or speech channel API.
Core Printing: no shell-drawn print sheet, no view pagination, and no print panel plug-in mechanism.
HIShape: no shape or region type with boolean operations.
Universal Access: no app-facing zoom focus API.
